skill: Nonlinear Equations In One Variable And Systems Of Equations In Two Variables
prompt:
[Figure 1]

The graph of a system of a linear equation and a nonlinear equation is shown. What is the solution $(x, y)$ to this system?
explanation: Choice C is correct. The solution $\left(x, y\right)$ to a system of two equations corresponds to the point where the graphs of the equations intersect in the xy-plane. The graphs of the linear equation and the nonlinear equation shown intersect at the point $\left(3, 4\right)$. Thus, the solution $\left(x, y\right)$ to this system is $\left(3, 4\right)$.
